title: Optimize project-test and hosted quality critical path
outOfScope: Removing, skipping, or weakening required tests, coverage, security, SBOM, provenance, installer, compatibility, or release evidence
Claiming performance improvement from one run, local-only timing, or unlike-for-like scenarios
Publishing a release, changing release identity, or modifying Branch Protection
Using unsafe high concurrency before proving test isolation
Deleting authoritative archived Work Item evidence from repository history

PR #412 provides the legal planned-verification Preflight transition used by this resumed Work Item.

Authoritative user-approved sequence, performance root-cause findings, and lifecycle requirements.

riskAssessment.reason: Changing installer payload, test fixtures, parallel ownership, and telemetry can hide regressions unless fail-closed equivalence and adopter lifecycle coverage are retained.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly approved prioritizing this corrective performance Work Item and continuous serial execution; release remains deferred.

preReviewWarnings: Do not confuse telemetry improvements with runtime improvements.
Installer payload exclusions require adopter upgrade, adoption, and lifecycle regression evidence.
Hosted acceptance requires at least three like-for-like runs and reports median/p95 without overclaiming.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Each quality invocation uses a run-isolated timing directory bound to commit and run/session identity; success, failure, cancellation, and timeout preserve timing, JUnit/slow-test evidence, and logs as hosted artifacts.
Gate subprocess output is streamed sufficiently to identify the active test/gate while preserving bounded machine-readable output tails and digests.

Installer payload excludes template-maintenance history that adopters do not require, while runtime skeleton, policies, baselines, adoption, upgrade, and full governance journey behavior remain covered by regression tests.
Repeated installer/lifecycle tests reuse a proven immutable package or fixture without cross-test mutation; any test sharding or parallelism is enabled only after isolation regressions pass.
template-smoke and installation-smoke execute independently where semantics permit, and a terminal aggregate Job requires all governed results without duplicate full-quality execution.

At least three like-for-like hosted post-change runs are compared with run 30280375075 and recent baselines; median and p95 are reported, with first-stage target quality p95 below 15 minutes or an explicit fail result and corrective follow-up.
English, Chinese, and Japanese quality documentation, the comprehensive plan, Summary, and instruction traceability state the same implementation, limits, measurements, and unresolved issues.
The complete Contract→preflight/checkpoint→implementation→verification→Summary→PR/CI→merge→archive→ai-close→branch cleanup→main synchronization lifecycle succeeds before the next Work Item starts.
guidelines: Do not trade evidence completeness, deterministic isolation, or coverage for speed.
Optimize measured structural costs before adding concurrency.
Treat archived template-maintenance history separately from adopter runtime payload and document the boundary.
Use source-bound, like-for-like hosted evidence and record failed performance targets honestly.

intent.problem: WI-21 proved the CI workflow can complete reliably, but hosted run 30280375075 still spent about 21 minutes 21 seconds in make quality. project-test is dominated by installer/governance journey tests that repeatedly copy and scan growing template history, while timing sessions are not run-isolated, gate output remains buffered, and timing/JUnit/slow-test evidence is not uploaded on all outcomes.
constraints: Preserve every required quality, security, supply-chain, installer, compatibility, and release evidence gate.
Use run 30280375075 as a source-bound pre-optimization hosted baseline and require at least three comparable post-change runs.
Do not directly enable high pytest concurrency until temporary-directory and output isolation are proven.
Do not publish or change a release; release remains after performance, omission, process, RFE, Japanese, and Trust Layer work.
Record every discovered implementation or workflow issue in the Summary and comprehensive plan before proceeding.
intent.rationale: The next release should not inherit a quality path whose cost grows with template history. Structural payload and fixture improvements, reliable diagnostics, and repeatable hosted evidence address the root cause rather than merely making a long run more observable.

rawUserRequest: 优先插入并执行完整的 make quality 与 GitHub Actions 深度性能优化工单：修复证据可靠性和实时诊断，缩小安装发行面，复用安装 fixture，安全拆分测试和并行 Job，并用至少三次同类型 hosted run 验收；所有工单继续按“指示—计划—实现—验收”双向追踪和完整 PR/合并/关闭/分支清理流程执行，发布延后。

declaredIntent.summary: Reduce the measured make quality critical path by addressing installer-history amplification, repeated fixtures, and hosted evidence gaps without weakening any gate.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Installer history is excluded but an adopter requires a runtime governance file.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Install, upgrade, adoption, and journey regressions fail closed before merge.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run installer, upgrade, adoption, and governance journey regressions against the reduced payload and assert every required runtime file remains installed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A reused fixture or test shard leaks mutations between tests.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Isolation regressions detect changed files, shared outputs, or order-dependent results and parallelism remains disabled.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add mutation and order-isolation regressions for any reused fixture, then run serial and proposed shard paths before enabling concurrency.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A quality gate fails, times out, or is cancelled.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Terminal evidence and uploaded timing/log/JUnit artifacts identify the exact gate and preserve a bounded diagnostic tail.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise success, failure, and timeout gate paths and statically verify hosted artifact upload uses always() with run-isolated paths.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: One fast hosted run appears to meet the target.
scenarioCoverage.expected: No improvement claim is made until at least three like-for-like runs support median and p95 comparison.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Collect at least three like-for-like hosted runs and compute median and p95 against run 30280375075 without using a single run as proof.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Parallel Job restructuring causes a required downstream result to be skipped.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The always-run terminal aggregate records skipped/failure accurately and fails closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run workflow architecture regressions for success, failure, cancellation, and skipped dependencies, then validate a real terminal ci-evidence job.
